requirements.text: The interface should load quickly and be intuitive.
The system shall email a receipt to the customer after every successful payment.
After each successful payment, the customer must receive a receipt by email.
The system must retain each audit log for at least 90 days after creation.
The system must permanently delete each audit log no later than 30 days after creation.
The application shall return search results within 2 seconds for queries matching up to 100 records.
The system shall encrypt all customer records stored in the database.
The production service shall be available for 99.9 percent of each calendar month.
If an export fails, the system shall record an error code and notify the operator.
The search screen shall support keyboard navigation between every control.
The application shall run without code changes on Windows 11 and Ubuntu 24.04.
